# Jayro Montesinos — Fine Art Photography

> Fine art photographer based in Valencia, Spain. Artistic nude, dance, portraits, still life, editorial campaigns (Estudio Mediterráneo) and photobooks. Limited edition fine art prints on Hahnemühle paper, signed and numbered. Private studio by appointment.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://jayromontesinos.com/): selected works
- [Biography](https://jayromontesinos.com/bio.html): career, exhibitions and publications
- [Press](https://jayromontesinos.com/prensa.html): media appearances
- [Books](https://jayromontesinos.com/libros.html): published photobooks
- [Dance](https://jayromontesinos.com/danza.html): fine art dance photography
- [Portraits](https://jayromontesinos.com/retratos.html)
- [Still Life](https://jayromontesinos.com/stilllife.html)
- [Estudio Mediterráneo](https://jayromontesinos.com/campanas.html): commercial and editorial work
- [Artistic Nude (18+)](https://jayromontesinos.com/desnudo-artistico.html)
